packageRules.description: Dev tooling: one weekly PR for minor and patch updates of dev dependencies; majors come one by one.
Convex: the client, the test harness and the Convex components move together.
Better Auth: @convex-dev/better-auth and better-auth must stay on versions that support each other.
Keep better-auth on 1.6: @convex-dev/better-auth 0.12.x peers on better-auth >=1.6.11 <1.7.0 (spec §10b). Lift this together with a component release that supports 1.7.
Next and React: next and eslint-config-next are pinned to the same exact version; react, react-dom and their types move together.
Tiptap: every @tiptap/* package must be on the same version.
Tauri: the JS API and CLI, and the Rust crates in apps/desktop/src-tauri.
